ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly high-intensity (white) central surface area comprising approximately 70-75% of visible pixels, contrasted against low-intensity (black) peripheral margins and mottled regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes consist of large white contiguous regions. Low-intensity (black) pixels form a dense margin along the trailing edge and distal tips. Dark mottling and radial streaking are concentrated near the median notch and spread outwards across the mid-ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45-55 degrees, showing a deep vertical inset towards the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, including several distinct deep notches on both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a jagged convex sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; lower margin shows a smooth concave trajectory leading to sharp lateral termination points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle scars/colonies) located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, embedded within dark peripheral pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple fine, dark-pixel linear disruptions (rake marks) scattered across the white ventral surface, particularly concentrated on the left lobe at oblique angles.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue irregularities and serrations along the trailing edge boundary; prominent barnacle or scar clusters on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated circular scar or ring-like pixel formation is visible in the interior white field of the right lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the distal tip.
